title: Effective Resistance and Graph Neural Network Reliability in Tissue-Specific Interactomes
abstract: arXiv:2610.02175v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Protein function annotation needs to know which predictions to distrust, not only what a model predicts. We ask whether tissue-specific interaction structure carries that information. Our candidate signal is effective resistance, used previously to relieve over-squashing by rewiring. Across 24 tissue-specific interactomes it is dominated by inverse degree, and the degeneration deepens as the co-expression filtered network grows, with a Spearman correlation of -0.955. The residual departure from that limit exceeds degree-preserving null graphs in all 24 networks. Controlling for predictive entropy, degree, annotation cardinality, local structure and feature-only difficulty, the residual explains additional per-node loss in 19 of 24 held-out networks once a permutation floor is subtracted, at every depth, and the effect strengthens monotonically with depth. translated_title: 有效电阻与组织特异性相互作用组中图神经网络的可靠性
translated_abstract: 蛋白质功能注释不仅需要知道模型预测了什么，还需要知道哪些预测不可信。我们探究组织特异性的相互作用网络结构是否携带这一信息。我们采用的候选信号是有效电阻，此前它被用于通过重连边来缓解过度压缩问题。在24个组织特异性相互作用组中，有效电阻主要被度的倒数所主导，并且随着共表达过滤网络的增大，这种退化程度进一步加深，Spearman相关系数为-0.955。在全部24个网络中，相对于该极限的残余偏离均超过了保持度不变的零模型图。在控制了预测熵、度、注释基数、局部结构以及仅基于特征的难度等因素之后，在减去置换下限的条件下，该残余量在24个留出网络中的19个里解释了额外的逐节点损失，且在每个深度上均成立，其效应随深度单调增强。该增量达到控制变量所未能解释方差的0.37%……
tldr: 该论文发现有效电阻在扣除度倒数主导效应后的残余信号，可用于预测组织特异性蛋白质相互作用网络中图神经网络逐节点预测的可靠性，在控制多种干扰因素后仍能额外解释节点级预测损失，且该效应随网络深度单调增强。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the residual of effective resistance beyond its inverse-degree-dominated limit serves as a per-node reliability signal for GNN predictions in tissue-specific protein interactomes, explaining additional prediction loss after controlling for entropy, degree, and local structure, with the effect strengthening monotonically with depth.
